dl.notes: Brief: hook = surprise list (marriage, ships, castles); format clipcard (expansion rule of 15 Oct; trailer and split capped for Wednesday); opener: the ship at sea at 64 s, crop following ship then deck; card «تصل في / 29 أكتوبر / بسعر 24.99 دولارًا» over the desert caravan (8 to 11 s); line 1 (ocean, shipbuilding) on the coast and the diver underwater; line 2 (romance, marriage) on two character close-ups; line 3 (houses, castles, business) on the castle, house building and the market; under it the trailer's music from 44 s (most tonal stretch, measured). 20.1 s. Footage is the September reveal (the new overview is YouTube only), IGN 4K, so the crop needs no enlargement. Arabic: both skills; glossary إضافة; Pearl Abyss «بيرل أبيس (Pearl Abyss)» as on 30 Sep. Back-check: «تخصيصها» read as allocation in the short line (customize in the caption); kept as the standard games term. Grammar: no required edits.
